Title: Why Your Thyroid Medication Might Not Be Working (3 Common Culprits)

Description:
Still exhausted and stuck at the same weight even though you take your thyroid pill every morning? It might not be your dose - it could be what you're eating around it.

Coffee, soy, and walnuts are three of the most common foods that block levothyroxine from fully absorbing, and each one just needs a simple timing fix.

Watch to find out why, and exactly how long to wait.
